versions.changelog:
costume-design-board v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for generating standardized, professional stage costume design boards and PDFs.
- Supports collating costume sketches and references into a print-quality layout with dedicated areas for full-body images, detail shots, character info, and design notes.
- Uses V9.1 layout specification: 6528×3100 px canvas, clear naming conventions for input files, and structured image placement.
- Includes example commands and detailed parameter references for local script execution.
- Offers robust guidance for layout, naming, and recommended fonts for text rendering.
